intro: Chicago's public sauna scene is anchored by old-school Russian-style bathhouses: Chicago Bath House in Wicker Park says it has operated since 1906, and Chicago Sweatlodge on the Northwest Side is a men-only banya with a restaurant. Newer options include a Finnish sauna and plunge club in Fulton Market, a thermal-bath circuit in River West, and a wood-fired sauna on Oak Street Beach that uses Lake Michigan water for its plunge. The bathhouses take walk-ins; most newer spots sell timed sessions, so book ahead.

venues.name: Chicago Bath House
venues.drop_in_price: $50 adult all-day admission (no re-entry); $25 child under 12 with an adult
venues.schedule: Walk-in, no reservation needed. Swimsuit required in the co-ed facility. Mon-Thu 10am-11pm, Fri 10am-midnight, Sat 7am-midnight, Sun 7am-11pm.
venues.notes: Formerly Red Square Spa. Robe, towels and slippers included with admission. Platza (venik) treatments from $50, restaurant and bar on site. Gift cards are sold in person only.

venues.name: Chicago Sweatlodge
venues.schedule: Men only. Unlimited same-day use. Hours Unknown (confirm before visiting).
venues.notes: Dry Russian sauna plus a wet Turkish-style room, with a restaurant on site. The venue's own website currently shows little information, so call ahead for prices and hours. WBEZ listed admission at $40 in March 2025.

venues.name: Eastend
venues.address: 1132 W Fulton Market, Chicago, IL 60607 (entrance on May St)
venues.schedule: Booked sessions. Mon-Thu 7am-12:30pm and 3:30-9pm, Fri 7am-9pm, Sat-Sun 9am-6pm. Bathing suit required.
venues.notes: Finnish-style sauna set at 180-194°F with towel-waving infusions. Arrive 15 minutes early; towels provided; barefoot beyond the changing rooms. 5-pack $179, 10-pack $335.

venues.name: AIRE Ancient Baths Chicago
venues.drop_in_price: Unknown (a September 2026 guide listed thermal-bath circuits from $150)
venues.schedule: Booking required. Mon 8am-10pm, Tue-Wed 9am-10pm, Thu 9am-11pm, Fri-Sun 8am-11pm; hours may vary on holidays.
venues.notes: Thermal baths at several temperatures in a converted factory building, closest stops Chicago and Grand. A pricier, quieter bathing circuit rather than a social sauna.

venues.name: Oak St. Sauna
venues.address: 1001 N Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL
venues.schedule: Social sessions up to 9 seats; 2-hour private rentals for up to 11 people. Seasonal (last season ran through March 31); current season dates Unknown.
venues.notes: Bring a swimsuit, towel, water bottle and flip-flops (towels $20). Changing room and lockers, but no bathroom at the sauna. Monthly unlimited pass $200. Hosts themed nights.
